key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to control coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle travel speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle, but gives no numerical results or validation metrics.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify parameter ranges or optimal settings, limiting direct transfer to production.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
